name: Superman Hold
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended straight overhead and your legs straight together behind you.
Squeeze your glutes and engage your back muscles to lift your chest, straight arms, and straight legs simultaneously off the floor.
Keep your head neutral looking down at the floor and lengthen through your fingertips and toes.
Hold the elevated arch position steadily while breathing calmly for the target duration, then relax back down to the floor.
tips: Avoid holding your breath while maintaining the isometric back and glute contraction.
Bend your elbows slightly into a W shape if extending straight overhead feels tight in your shoulders.
